Neither the operators own page nor the press article gives a specific street number. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned 7842 Ritchie Hwy, Glen Burnie, MD 21061 at 0.9 confidence, Ritchie Highway being the main road through Glen Burnie near Fort Meade, consistent with the operators own area description. Given the operators own confirmation of the specific area, campus size, and building history, corroborated by a same area reverse geocode of this rows own coordinates, this session applies 7842 Ritchie Hwy as this rows address, noting the specific street number comes from the geocode rather than the operators own page.
